correctness.rationale: The prefix and suffix zero counts imply abelian equivalence iff the two complementary Dyck heights both vanish. The unique smallest pair of return times decomposes an ordered Dyck pair into a minimal pair and two arbitrary Dyck remainders, giving E(t)=1-1/S(t). Concatenating the outer pair around an arbitrary middle Dyck word proves U(z)=C(z)/S(z²) and B_(n,j)=E_j*C_(n-2j). The telescoping finite Catalan-square sum and hypergeometric boundary expansion yield limiting density pi/(16-4pi). Verified actual standalone verify.py: 290511 Dyck words, 19414 pairs, exact integer recurrences to n=30. Experiments do not replace the all-length proof.

A complete all-semength border-free enumeration, exact first-border length law, and explicit nonzero asymptotic density close a natural conditioned enumeration gap.
